title: Facebook Messenger for Social Customer Support - How it works?
description: Learn how you can provide social support on Facebook messenger using REVE Chat's omni channel live chat platform. This demo guides you through how you can integrated Facebook channel and manage your customer conversations with REVE Chat to deliver social engagement and support.  To learn more, please visit: https://www.revechat.com/facebook-messaging/  #facebook #integration #omnichannel

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it demonstrates connecting a Facebook business page to a support dashboard so agents can answer visitor messages in one place. The interaction shown is routine customer support, with no observed offer involving investment, payment, or financial participation. The Facebook login is presented as part of the integration walkthrough, without establishing credential theft, impersonation, or a deceptive outcome.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content is an operational technology demonstration: it instructs viewers how to integrate a Facebook business page with REVE Chat and use the resulting customer-support chat workflow.
